title: What Underground Mushroom Caverns Is
definition: Underground Mushroom Caverns: mushroom farms in caves and tunnels.
description:

title: Real Research Today: Underground Mushroom Caverns
definition: Today's documented research behind Underground Mushroom Caverns.
description:
The road to Underground Mushroom Caverns is already being paved. Vertical farming (AeroFarms, Plenty) grows leafy greens with 95% less water. The Good Food Institute tracks 100+ cultivated-meat companies toward price parity.

The FAO projects food production must rise ~50% by 2050 for 10 billion people. Together these programs form the climate control foundation that Underground Mushroom Caverns will build on — the cavern logistics results, the substrate supply methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as cavern logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

t: 2030 — First cavern hulls products reach price parity: climate control
title: 2030 — First cavern hulls products reach price parity: climate control
definition: 2030 milestone on the Underground Mushroom Caverns roadmap.
description:
First cavern hulls products reach price parity: climate control cultivation at commercial scale.

What must be true first: the climate control results have to replicate outside the lab, cavern logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and substrate supply operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed climate control demonstrations, cavern logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting substrate supply uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Underground Mushroom Caverns
definition: Estimates Underground Mushroom Caverns readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Underground Mushroom Caverns components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a cavern hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

definition: Simulates Underground Mushroom Caverns operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Underground Mushroom Caverns installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 85023 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where climate control monitoring, cavern logistics redundancy, or substrate supply maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Underground Mushroom Caverns Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Underground Mushroom Caverns: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Underground Mushroom Caverns — mushroom farms in caves and tunnels.

Phase 1 — Prove (climate control): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (cavern logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (substrate supply): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (harvest): cavern hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and rural-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
